subject: GreenBank SOC2: request for isolation evidence and network snapshot
messages:
From: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@greenbank.com>

Cc: procurement@greenbank.com
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:12:00 -04:00
Subject: SOC2 ask — network isolation evidence for Dedicated/Private

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the walk-through this morning. As part of GreenBank's SOC2 evidence collection we need a concise package showing how Redwood isolates customer workloads in Dedicated and Private modes. Specifically we are looking for:

- A network diagram that highlights tenant segmentation boundaries and control plane/data plane separation (labels for CIDR ranges optional).
- A control matrix mapping isolation controls to SOC2 CC criteria (high level).
- Any runbook or step that demonstrates tenant failover or canarying between capacity tiers (for auditing).

Can you share a snapshot we can attach to our SOC2 evidence binder by EOD Pacific? If you need more time, a plan and ETA will work.

We will treat redactions as needed; the goal is to show design and controls rather than live secrets.

Thanks,
Alice Moreno
Sr. Infosec Analyst — GreenBank Financial
[Attachment: greenbank_soc2_template_v2.docx (DOCX, 120KB)]

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear checklist. We can get a focused evidence bundle together today. Planned deliverables:

1) High-level network diagram (PDF) with tenant fences, control plane demarcation, and egress guardrails.
2) Segmentation control matrix (XLSX) mapping to SOC2 CC controls.
3) Evidence manifest (PDF) listing artifact sources and redaction notes.

Kimberly, Karthik — looping you in to prepare the artifacts. Kimberly, can you include any runbook excerpt that demonstrates the canary/fallback path? Karthik, can you confirm whether we can safely include CIDR ranges or if we should keep those redacted?

Alice — ETA EOD Pacific (we will prioritize the diagram + matrix). If procurement needs a contract reference or delivery receipt, let us know.

Best,

Notes/highlights:
- Diagram intentionally omits production CIDRs and some platform hostnames; we call those out in the manifest.

Alice — if you want CIDRs included for your auditor, we can provide them under an NDA addendum.

Alice — quick follow-up after reviewing the attachments. A couple of clarifications that auditors often ask for:

- Can you confirm whether you need logical identifiers (tenant IDs) correlated to the diagram, or is a role-based mapping sufficient? We prefer not to put tenant IDs in the diagram; a role-bound mapping documented in the matrix is usually acceptable.
- For the canary failover, do you want a short operational log sample? We can provide a scrubbed excerpt showing the ID of the test canary run and state transitions (redacted tokens).

Marissa / Tessa — can you prepare a one-page ops note describing the canary validation checklist and attach a scrubbed log sample if Alice requests it? Mark as ‘for auditors only’ in the manifest.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Inference Ops — Redwood Inference
